dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.axial_tapering: Symmetrical 2D narrowing from the mid-back region toward the posterior peduncle, characterized by a smooth curvilinear reduction in visible width.
dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.planar_edge_undulation: No localized structural deviations, bulges, or indentations are visible along the lateral margins; the edges appear smooth and bilaterally symmetrical.

surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.global_grayscale_baseline: Mature white; high median pixel intensity across the dorsal surface with no significant dark pigmentation remaining.
surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.mottling_density_and_topology: Low frequency; limited to faint, light-grey linear streaks and a subtle longitudinal darkening along the central dorsal ridge.
surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.transition_boundaries: Diffuse; the gradient between slightly darker longitudinal streaks and the white baseline skin is gradual and lacks sharp definition.

high_frequency_epidermal_anomalies.localized_point_contrast_disruptions: Visible set of three to four faint, parallel, light-colored linear marks (rake marks) situated diagonally across the mid-dorsal plane.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Parallel diagonal linear markings on the mid-dorsal region consistent with healed intraspecific rake marks.
other_distinctive_markers: Prominent dark oval point corresponding to the blowhole location, providing high contrast against the surrounding white cephalic region.
